name: Form Agent
description: Bounded OpenClaw + Telegram orchestration of the accepted Form Agent CLI. Submission requires host-mediated operator approval.

accountId.description: Dedicated (non-default) Telegram account id from deployment config.

operatorSenderId.description: The single frozen numeric Telegram operator id.

adapterBinaryPath.description: Absolute path to the form-agent-openclaw adapter binary.

adapterConfigPath.description: Absolute path to the data-only adapter deployment config.

allowedDraftProviders.description: Local draft-provider allowlist (subset of reference, openai-compatible).

providerEnvNames.description: Exact credential env-var NAMES forwarded to the Form Agent child.
